agent.result_text:
Sheet notes are in, and the notes test ("sheet notes") passes. But 2 of the 4 tests in the spec still fail, and `bin/e2e` itself didn't get a clean run.

**Test results.** The machine was heavily loaded (load average ~22), so the app took about 70 seconds to start. `bin/e2e` only waits 60, so its tests ran before the app was up and all failed. I started the app myself and ran the specs against it one at a time:

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| sheet notes | ✓ passes |
| sheet notes scenario 1 | ✓ passes |
| sheet notes scenario 2 | ✘ fails at line 544: `person-claimed` for Cam shows `99.95`, expected `0.00` |
| sheet notes scenario 3 | ✘ fails at line 1037: a claim for Ben (4.00 on 2026-03-09, ref R-2) is accepted, but the test expects it refused |

Scenarios 2 and 3 never use notes. They test existing claim, plan and rate rules, and failed at the same lines both before and after my last change. I don't think my change causes them, but I haven't proved that with a run on the code without notes. Fixing them means changing business rules that have nothing to do with this request, so I left them alone. Tell me if you want me to investigate.

**What I built:**
- **Data:** a new `sheet_note` table (`V103__sheet_note.sql`) holding the text, who added it, and the sheet's today at the time.
- **Server:** `GET` and `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/notes`, in a new `note` package. A blank note gets a 400 and writes nothing. Viewers and archived sheets are already refused by the app's existing check on every change. A note added under a delegation gets the existing `for=<steward>` ending on its audit line. Each added note writes `NOTE_ADDED sheet=… by=… text=…`.
- **Front end:** a Notes section with `note-text`, `note-add`, `note-error`, and one `note-line` per note, newest first, shown as `2026-03-11 uma: third`.
- **One small change outside notes:** loading a sheet in `SheetPicker.tsx` now also fetches its notes before the sheet shows as loaded. Without this, the test sometimes counted the note lines before they had arrived and wrongly treated a refused add as having gone through.
